LanguageData.VRE_AnimalFeeder.description: Carriers of this gene have small retractable fangs and an organ on the roof of the mouth which can extract hemogen from fresh warm blood. They can bite any animal, suck the blood, and gain hemogen directly. This can sometimes make the animal attack the gene carrier.
LanguageData.VRE_AnimalFeeder.label: animalfeeder
LanguageData.VRE_BatEars.description: Carriers of this gene have bat-like ears.
LanguageData.VRE_BatEars.label: bat ears
LanguageData.VRE_BatNose.description: Carriers of this gene have bat-like leaf nose.
LanguageData.VRE_BatNose.label: bat nose
LanguageData.VRE_CorpseFeeder.description: Carriers of this gene have small retractable fangs and an organ on the roof of the mouth which can extract hemogen from cold, rotting blood. They can bite any human corpse, suck the blood, and gain hemogen directly.
LanguageData.VRE_CorpseFeeder.label: corpsefeeder
LanguageData.VRE_Ecstasy.description: Carriers of this gene can psychically connect with the target briefly, granting them a sense of ecstasy and making them fall in love with the caster.
LanguageData.VRE_Ecstasy.label: ecstasy
LanguageData.VRE_ExtremeHemogenDrain.description: Carriers lose an additional 12 hemogen per day from biological entropy.
LanguageData.VRE_ExtremeHemogenDrain.label: extreme hemogen drain
LanguageData.VRE_FilterInfection.description: Carriers of this gene have special glands in their mouths that allow them to filter infected blood from the clean blood.
LanguageData.VRE_FilterInfection.label: filter infection
LanguageData.VRE_HeartCrush.description: Carriers of this gene have special adrenaline glands that allow them to find the beating heart of the opponent and rip it out in a mad fury.
LanguageData.VRE_HeartCrush.label: heart crush
LanguageData.VRE_Hemosmosis.description: Carriers of this gene are able to drain blood from their environment, provided there is blood to be drained there.
LanguageData.VRE_Hemosmosis.label: hemosmosis
LanguageData.VRE_LowHemogenDrain.description: Carriers lose an additional 4 hemogen per day from biological entropy.
LanguageData.VRE_LowHemogenDrain.label: low hemogen drain
LanguageData.VRE_Resurrect.description: Carriers have a reserve of unique resurrector archites which can infuse a corpse, rebuild degenerated tissue and kickstart the vital processes. This brings the dead back to life - though possibly with health issues. This can only be done very rarely, and comes at a steep hemogen cost.
LanguageData.VRE_Resurrect.label: resurrect
LanguageData.VRE_SanguineHair.description: Carriers of this gene have their hair naturally styled into elder sanguine hairstyles.
LanguageData.VRE_SanguineHair.label: sanguine haired
LanguageData.VRE_SanguoFeeder.description: Carriers of this gene have small retractable fangs and an organ on the roof of the mouth which can extract hemogen from fresh warm blood of other sanguophages. They can bite an unresisting sanguophage, suck the blood, and gain hemogen directly.
LanguageData.VRE_SanguoFeeder.label: sanguofeeder
LanguageData.VRE_Sensitivity_Dangerous.description: Carriers of this gene have biological compounds in their skin that react dangerously to UV radiation. They are extremely sensitive to sunlight.
LanguageData.VRE_Sensitivity_Dangerous.label: dangerous UV sensitivity
LanguageData.VRE_Talons.description: Carriers of this gene have hands that partially resemble talons. This reduces their ability to manipulate objects, but allows them to perform special attacks in melee combat.
LanguageData.VRE_Talons.label: talons
LanguageData.VRE_ToxicCloud.description: Carriers of this gene are able to excrete a thick toxic smoke from special organic reservoirs in their lungs. Tox gas is deadly to almost every creature.
LanguageData.VRE_ToxicCloud.label: toxic cloud
LanguageData.VRE_UpperBatEars.description: Carriers of this gene have pointy bat-like ears.
LanguageData.VRE_UpperBatEars.label: chiropteric ears
LanguageData.VRE_ViscuousGoo.description: Carriers grow glands in the neck that generate and store a thick goo. They can spit it over long distances and cover several people in a viscous goo that will slow them down.
LanguageData.VRE_ViscuousGoo.label: viscuous goo
